## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.23.1.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.23.1.pdf** |
| Controls and rules on one sheet, two-sided, to keep by the keyboard | **Cognitive-Terrain-Quick-Reference-0.23.1.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.23.1.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.23 build (0.23.0, 0.23.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **Warmer colours.** The map's area outlines and fills, and the labels on the
  panels and screens, are a soft cream again instead of grey, so the board no
  longer looks washed out. Gold stays for what needs you now.
- **Fixed:** the Their edge on you heading showed as a flat light-grey bar.
- Two-player codes from 0.23.0 still work.
